nodes.text: Videos circulating on social media show overwhelmed hospitals and healthcare systems.HMPV, first discovered in 2001, belongs to the same family as respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) and causes respiratory

Symptoms include cough, fever, sore throat, and shortness of breath.
